pages.title: Things That Go Boom In The Night/Quick guide
A Room With A Garou/Quick guide

main.content:
'''Ratcatcher''' is a [[quest]] where you can learn about fighting and cooking.

* Talk to [[Vannaka]].
* Head to the windmill in the north of [[Temple Woods]].
* Kill four [[giant rat]]s and get four [[raw rat meat]]s. 
* Cook two [[rat roast]]s. 
** You will need to make a [[campfire]] using 4 [[ash log]]s and 4 [[stone]]s.
** You will also need [[ash logs]] to fuel the fire
* Return to Vannaka with the cooked rat roasts.

''Congratulation. Quest complete!''

==Reward==
* 1 [[stone logging axe]]
* 1 [[stone dagger]]

{{Quests}}

'''Rune Mysteries''' is a [[quest]] where Zanik will teach you about magic.

* Talk to [[Zanik]]
* Obtain 50 [[ash logs]]
** You can obtain ash logs by picking up spawns from the ground or uprooting [[Sapling|Ash Saplings]].
** You can also create a [[stone logging axe]] using 6 [[stone]] and 8 [[ash logs]] at the [[crafting table]] and use this to cut [[ash tree]]s.  
* Return to Zanik
* Mine [[rune essence]] using the [[stone pickaxe]] which Zanik gives you. Rune essence can be mined from the lumps of essence on the ground next to [[rune essence geyser]]s. 
* Build a [[rune altar]]. This requires 12 [[stone]] and 4 [[rune essence]]. 
* Craft some [[air rune]]s and [[astral rune]]s.
* Return to Zanik.

''Congratulations. Quest complete!''

==Rewards==
* 50 [[air rune]]
* 50 [[astral rune]]
* 1 [[Tome of Woodcutting - Vol 1.]]

{{Quests}}
